- Row 15 had an invalid date ("TBD"); it was set to missing, so that row is excluded from the monthly totals (40 of 41 rows used).
- Rows 13 and 29 had Revenue values that violated the rules formula Revenue = Quantity × Price (450 vs 45, and 1500 vs 15); they were recomputed from the formula.

Other issues noticed but not relevant to this question (left untouched): Category has misspelled/case variants (Accesories, Electornics, Office Suplies, etc.) and Region has whitespace variants; these don't affect monthly revenue totals.
